subject: maths
question:
Find the mean (up to 2 decimal points) of the following numbers:

8.9, 6.5, 7.8, 12.3, 15.6, 14.4, 9.8
solution:
Given:

8.9, 6.5, 7.8, 12.3, 15.6, 14.4, 9.8

Concept used:

Total = Mean × Number of entities

Calculation:

Mean = (8.9 + 6.5 + 7.8 + 12.3 + 15.6 + 14.4 + 9.8) ÷ 7 ≈ 10.76

**∴ The mean is 10.76.**
